name: pinecone
description: Vector database access powered by the official Pinecone Developer MCP server — search Pinecone documentation, manage serverless indexes with integrated inference, upsert and semantically search records, rerank results, and run cascading queries across multiple indexes.

interface.shortDescription: Query and manage Pinecone vector indexes from the agent via the official MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Your agent can store and search through data using Pinecone's vector database — perfect for building AI applications with semantic search, recommendation systems, and retrieval-augmented generation. Just give your agent text to index or a search query, and it handles the embeddings and vector search automatically. No need to manage embedding pipelines yourself.
defaultPrompt: Search my Pinecone index for content similar to this text.
Help me index these documents for semantic search.
Show me the status of my Pinecone indexes.
